text:
maria: FYI nightly eval blew up on the legal-qa promptset — ~12% drop vs yesterday. Samples look like repeated clauses and truncated endings, not just scoring noise. Attaching quick repro.

maria: repro curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"openlm-6.9b\",\"prompt\":\"Draft a short indemnity clause...\",\"max_tokens\":128,\"temperature\":0.8,\"top_k\":50}'
```

maria: sample prompt / outputs:
```
PROMPT: \"Draft a short indemnity clause for a SaaS contract.\"

BASELINE:
\"The vendor shall indemnify and hold harmless the customer from...\"

NIGHTLY:
\"The vendor shall indemnify and hold harmless the customer from the vendor's negligence... the vendor shall indemnify and hold harmless the customer from the vendor's negligence... the vendor shall indemnify and hold harmless the customer...\"
```

ashwin: :eyes: is this the quantized variant or a runtime-only change? Nightly runs the q4/q8 mix model.

sasha: We merged an attention refactor (PR #4721) yesterday to reduce stalls. It changed causal-mask padding handling inside the attention kernel. PR: https://git.internal/pr/4721

sasha: There's also a tiny RNG tweak in sampler.c that affects top_k determinism. Could be a bad interaction.

ashwin: I reproduced locally with image redwood/runtime:nightly-2026-03-18. Repeat happens even with temperature=0.7 and different seeds. Looks like KV cache reuse across prefixes — outputs repeat previously generated fragment.

maria: CI artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/1769004821/nightly-eval.tar.gz (promptset + diffs + example generations)

ci-bot: nightly-eval job failed: regression-threshold-exceeded on legal-qa (delta=-0.12). Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/9273

kevin: If it's kernel-level we should rollback canary to 4720 and re-run full eval. I'll queue a rollback now.

sasha: Can reproduce on canary. Quick workaround: set env RW_ATTEN_MASK_MODE=legacy to force old mask logic — that restores correct behavior on my node.

sasha: I'll prepare a patch to fix mask padding handling and add KV-cache alignment tests. Patch ETA ~30m.

ashwin: Minimal repro script I used:
```
python repro.py --model openlm-6.9b --prompt-file samples.txt --sampling temp=0.7 top_k=50
```

maria: After setting RW_ATTEN_MASK_MODE=legacy my local nightly eval is within 1% of baseline. Looks like a solid signal.

kevin: Rolling back canary now. Also adding a regression gate to prevent attention kernel flips without eval approval.

sasha: Follow-up: adding unit test that exercises variable prefix lengths + random top_k seeds to catch KV misalignment.

maria: Please add a short note in the runbook and tag root cause as \"attention mask padding change interacting with sampling RNG causing KV cache reuse across prefixes\" :thinking:

deploy-bot: Canary rollback to runtime:2026-03-17-4720 initiated by kevin.

ashwin: I'll run an extended nightly eval tonight and report back if anything else shows up.

maria: :thumbsup:
